title: Naanu Matthu Gunda 2
desc: A devoted dog does not move from his owner's grave, maintaining a constant watch. Years later, a young boy develops a unique bond with the loyal dog, resulting in an incredible companionship.

title: Obba
desc: A man aspires to join the Indian Police Service. But when a business tycoon kills his sister, he strives to take revenge.

title: Bheema Theeradalli
desc: Chandappa, a dreaded dacoit, gets deceived by a corrupt politician, Shashikanth. But fate intervenes when the latter's sister ends up falling in love with Chandappa.

title: Guru Shishyaru
desc: Manohar, a former Kho-Kho national champion, joins a school as a PT teacher to garner experience and make some money. However, he inadvertently bonds with his students and the villagers.

title: Mylari
desc: Tired of his dull village life, a young man heads to Bengaluru to make a mark. However, the bustling city overwhelms him, leading to experiences that completely change his life.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Vijaya Kankana
desc: Four honest and fierce individuals Shankar, Vijaya, Naina, and Amar come together to fight against the corrupt officials who have been exploiting citizens.

title: Thothapuri: Chapter 1
desc: A Hindu tailor and a Muslim banker, both with a witty outlook on life, fall in love. However, their differing religious beliefs create problems, testing their bond.
